theorem: At a fixed site and unchanged renewed-target phase, after genuine personal success on a renewed packet, the successful personally chosen port equals the target of every next available renewed packet. Keeping that register yields correct next FORAGE at the minimum one-instruction fee. Arbitrarily older history cannot improve that next port choice or its immediate food reward over an intact last-successful-port reference.

proof: Success feedback1 occurs only when chosen port equals target on an available packet.
Renewed target is a function of site/seed and phase only; it has no packet-specific term. No hash output need be evaluated.
FORAGE does not overwrite the chosen-port register. Under unchanged context it already contains a perfect next-port answer.
A successful reference action attains success1 and maximal source-defined food reward for the matched state, at the common minimum basefee1. Additional older history cannot exceed either bound.
This proves one-action port sufficiency, not full ecological sufficiency, phenotype accessibility or a universally optimal lifetime policy.
fixed_port_comparison: Both target labels0/1 are covered. In each case the fixed port equal to that target ties the intact cache for the next action without paying acquisition; the opposite fixed port fails. No universally correct fixed choice, real unseen target distribution, or aggregate fixed-policy advantage is asserted.
reference_cost_scope: Keeping an already personally chosen successful register across the invariant context needs no extra STORE/LOAD. This is not a zero-cost global last-success tracking controller: success detection, switching between registers/locations, validity, phase tracking and all program control must be paid and qualified in a complete implementation. The success/renewal conditions here are theorem premises, not privileged inputs supplied to an organism.
fee_interpretation: Earlier N-A optimistic savings was against blind two-port probing, not against this intact same-context cache. If both cache/reference use one correct FORAGE per later packet, additional READ acquisition cannot yield port-dispatch savings against the reference. Acquisition may still matter for obtaining a bit initially; that full paid implementation is unqualified.
feedback_overwrite_boundary: A wrong or empty B probe writes feedback0 but need not erase the last SUCCESSFUL A port. Overwriting feedback alone therefore does not establish an information advantage over a last-successful-port comparator. A genuine successful B observation can replace a global last-successful port; lawful necessary repurposing of the chosen register is another possible boundary but cannot be imposed for free.

phase_boundary: Across2048 the raw renewed target flips. Raw olderA and raw last-successfulA answers both become wrong; old raw history alone has no established benefit. Phase/timing inference would require a lawful, paid mechanism and comparison with equally informed finite-state controls.
erasure_control: Erasing both candidate old bit and comparator last-successful-port state demonstrates dependence on the removed information, not superiority over an intact comparator. Keep a separate intact cheap reference and cost-matched sham; distinguish causal information use from older-history advantage or evolved origin.
exact_nontrivial_next_falsifier: Find a lawful funded success at A on renewed food, then a genuinely useful success at B or necessary paid state overwrite, then return to A in the same target phase with renewed food still available. Match current feedback/context and allow free-policy references to remain atA or avoid the trip. Require a prospective untouched case family where oldA is not recoverable from currentB/cheap cues. If every competitive route can retain/recover the same answer in the equally cheap last-successful or location-specific finite-state cache, reject older-history superiority for that route.
cross_location_limits: The four symbolic A/B labels do not establish that the real hash family supplies informative variation or matched lawful histories. A location-specific cache is a required memory-positive comparator; its validity/location/phase tracking, acquisition and retrieval costs are not free or qualified.
productive_departure: Global material/COPY/formation laws do not by themselves require a location change. The previous paid reproduction-return energy certificate did not establish a genuine need to leave; no forced starvation, travel, resource protection or modified law is admitted here.

reproducibility.method: Parse exact scientific source as AST only, no import. Four local identities: t in {0,1}, E in {1,64}, p=t, E_after=E-1+min(20,65-E). Four symbolic A/B equalities: last=B, old=A. Four phase equalities: target=latent XOR phase. No actual hash outputs evaluated.
